source.title: Niki Lauda — Formula 1 Hall of Fame
source.author: Gerald Donaldson
source.locator: See precise paragraph or heading locator on each claim.
source.verification_note: Formula 1 Hall of Fame text inspected on 2026-10-24; primary publisher evidence only, independent corroboration and human review outstanding.

claims.en: Lauda's Ferrari period produced the 1975 and 1977 world titles. After leaving Formula 1 in 1979, he returned with McLaren and won the 1984 championship.
claims.uk: Період Лауди у Ferrari приніс чемпіонські титули 1975 та 1977 років. Після відходу з Формули-1 у 1979 році він повернувся з McLaren і здобув титул 1984 року.

evidence.locator: Hall of Fame heading '1975, 1977, 1984'; 1975 Ferrari, 1977 comeback and 1984 McLaren paragraphs.
FIA obituary, paragraphs 'With Ferrari he won...' and 'He was enticed back...' (1975/1977, 1979 exit, 1982 McLaren, 1984 title).

claims.en: Lauda crashed at the Nürburgring in 1976 and returned to Formula 1 racing at the Italian Grand Prix that season.
claims.uk: Лауда потрапив в аварію на Нюрбургринзі у 1976 році та повернувся до перегонів Формули-1 на Гран-прі Італії того ж сезону.

evidence.locator: 1976 German Grand Prix crash paragraph and six-weeks-later Italian Grand Prix return paragraph.
FIA obituary, paragraph 'With Ferrari he won...' and paragraph 'Despite being close to death...' (1976 crash and Italian GP return).

claims.en: Lauda joined Ferrari for the 1974 Formula 1 season.
claims.uk: Лауда приєднався до Ferrari в сезоні Формули-1 1974 року.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'For 1973 he talked his way': joining Enzo Ferrari in 1974.
FIA obituary, paragraph 'Born in Vienna in 1949': Ferrari signed Lauda for the 1974 season.

claims.en: After his Nürburgring accident, Lauda returned to racing at the 1976 Italian Grand Prix.
claims.uk: Після аварії на Нюрбургринзі Лауда повернувся до перегонів на Гран-прі Італії 1976 року.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Six weeks later': fourth place at 1976 Italian Grand Prix.
FIA obituary, paragraph 'Despite being close to death': returned at 1976 Italian Grand Prix 40 days after crash.

claims.en: Lauda returned to Formula 1 with McLaren in 1982.
claims.uk: Лауда повернувся до Формули-1 з McLaren у 1982 році.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'Lauda Air': McLaren contract signed in 1982.
FIA obituary, paragraph 'He was enticed back to the sport in 1982': joining McLaren.

claims.en: Lauda won the 1984 Drivers' Championship ahead of McLaren team-mate Alain Prost.
claims.uk: Лауда виграв чемпіонат світу 1984 року, випередивши напарника по McLaren Алена Проста.

evidence.locator: Paragraph beginning 'In 1984 he won his third driving title': Alain Prost team-mate margin.
FIA obituary, paragraph 'He was enticed back to the sport in 1982': 1984 title, Prost and half-point margin.
